subject: Recap + restart playbook for FoldAI trial kickoff
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@foldai.com>, Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@foldai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:10:00-04:00
Subject: Recap + restart playbook for FoldAI trial kickoff

Hi Liam / Sasha — great to meet today. Quick written recap while it's fresh and a lightweight playbook to get the trial unstuck if you want to restart the kickoff this week. MAP attached.

Call highlights:
- Goal: validate semantic search latency under 2x P99 compared to baseline and measure embedding throughput for 50k/month use-case.
- Constraint: FoldAI infra uses shorter context windows (~1k tokens), hoping we can avoid extra KV cache tuning.
- Blocker observed: telemetry not reporting usage to our test tenant (no ingestion events).

Suggested 30‑minute restart playbook (low lift) — steps I can run with you: 
1) Confirm API key & env: quick checklist (5 min).
2) Turn on debug telemetry for one test dataset (5–10 min).
3) Run canonical prompt set from MAP (10–15 min).
4) Review logs together and capture perf delta (10 min).

If you'd like, I can book a pairing slot with one of our SREs and we can do steps 1–3 together. I attached the mutual action plan (MAP-FoldAI-20261012.pdf) and an ICS for an optional pairing session.

Attachments: MAP-FoldAI-20261012.pdf, pairing-invite.ics

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime and tooling
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@foldai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: quick check — can we pair this week? (FoldAI trial)

Hi Liam — circling back on the MAP I sent last week. We haven't seen ingestion events from your test tenant yet, so nothing has shown up on the trial dashboard.

If priority shifted, totally understand — just want to make it easy to restart. Two options:
- 15‑minute quick check to confirm API key + telemetry toggle; or
- 30‑minute pairing session with one of our SREs (we'll also run the canonical prompt set).

Proposed times (PT): Tue 10/20 9:30am, Tue 10/20 3:00pm, Wed 10/21 10:00am. Reply with a slot that works or say if you'd prefer we pause the trial for now.

If helpful, we can also offer a one-time onboarding credit and an SRE-run troubleshooting window — I'll loop Aditya if you want that option.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing where this sits on your priority list.

Best,
Chloe
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:12:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: quick check — can we pair this week? (internal)

Aditya — forwarding the bump to Liam. FoldAI still hasn't sent ingestion events; no usage yet. They sounded interested on the call but may be deprioritizing.

As discussed on our QBR, I'm asking for a one-time onboarding credit (up to $1,200 in SRE hours) plus a 1‑hour SRE pairing to get telemetry flowing. This will let us collect perf signals and move the trial to an internal evaluation.

Why I think it's worth it:
- Small cost relative to expected deal size (we're looking at a $120k ARR baseline if they go to production).
- Removes the technical friction point that's blocking evaluation.

If you approve, I'll offer the credit in the next email and propose the Tue/Wed slots.

Thanks,
Chloe
